# Aseda Praise (https://elson222.github.io/aseda-praise/)

> Ghana's Premier Annual Gospel Concert & Community Healthcare Outreach Event in Tarkwa, Western Region.

## Event Overview
Aseda Praise is an annual flagship gospel music concert and community healthcare outreach event in Tarkwa, Ghana. Organised under the banner "Ten Thousand Hearts, One Voice!", the program brings together tens of thousands of worshippers, gospel minstrels (such as Joe Mettle, Ohemaa Mercy, and ACP Kofi Sarpong), and regional choirs.

## Official Media & Charitable Projects
- **Tarkwa Apinto Hospital Children's Ward**: Aseda Praise officially renovated and dedicated the Children's Ward at Apinto Government Hospital in Tarkwa.
- **Annual Senior Citizens Health Screening**: Free health examinations, eye screening, and medication distribution for senior citizens.
- **Official YouTube Channel**: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCEx6CVwi11sMM8e5juAkksA
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/aseda.praise/
- **Official Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/asedapraisetarkwa/

## Contact Information
- **Event Location**: Tarkwa, Western Region, Ghana
- **Admission**: 100% Free Entry — Open to the Public
